description: Neocortical neuronogenetic interval E11-E17 (11 integer cell cycles CC1-CC11): power-law cell-cycle exit fraction Q(CC) = min(1, k * CC^a) and cycle length T_C lengthening from 8.1 h to 18.4 h primarily via G1.
citations: Caviness, Takahashi & Nowakowski 2000, in Nelson & Luciana, eds., Handbook of Developmental Cognitive Neuroscience, MIT Press, pp. 7-22

cycles.quantity: number of integer cell cycles of the neuronogenetic interval

k.quantity: scale k of the leaving fraction Q(CC) = min(1, k * CC^a)
k.method: This repository's fit of a power law to the measured Q (0.11 at E12, 0.19 at E13, 0.34 at E14, 0.59 at E15, 0.54 at E16 for the whole proliferative population; extrapolated to 0 at E11 and to 1.0 early on E17). Q of CC1-CC7 and CC11 is not measured.

a.quantity: exponent a of the leaving fraction Q(CC) = min(1, k * CC^a)
a.method: Same fit as for k; the power-law form is not a formula of the paper.

basal_death_prob_per_cycle.quantity: probability that a progenitor dies in one cell cycle
basal_death_prob_per_cycle.note: Not measured. Pyknosis and electron-microscopy counts give 0% to a few percent in the proliferative zone and ISEL+ staining gives 50-70% (Blaschke et al. 1996), which Takahashi et al. 1996 find unclear because it would preclude growth of the epithelium ('unknown but probably small'). 0.01 is a modelling choice inside the low range.

T_C_hours.quantity: cell-cycle length for each of the 11 integer cycles
T_C_hours.method: Measured per embryonic day (Table 1 of Takahashi et al. 1995, cycle started at 9:00 on E11-E16: 8.1, 10.2, 11.4, 15.1, 17.5, 18.4 h). Per-cycle values read from that table by linear interpolation at the time each cycle starts, 18.4 h held after E16; the 11 cycles then take 140 h, consistent with 11 cycles over E11-E17. An earlier table ended at 20.0 h, which the paper does not give.

T_G1_hours.quantity: length of the G1 phase for each of the 11 integer cycles
T_G1_hours.method: T_G1 = T_C - (T_S + T_G2+M) per embryonic day (Table 1 of Takahashi et al. 1995: 3.2, 3.3, 5.5, 9.3, 11.8, 12.4 h; T_G2+M is 2.0 h throughout and T_S about 4 h without trend), a fourfold increase; interpolated per cycle as for T_C.

reference_*.quantity: reference outputs of the model (leaving fraction, progenitor pool and neuron output per cycle, neurons per founder)
reference_*.method: Computed from k, a and the number of cycles with PVE_n = 2 * PVE_(n-1) * P_(n-1) and OUT_n = 2 * PVE_n * Q_n; checked by tests/test_stages_cell_cycle.py. Not measurements: the with-death value uses basal_death_prob_per_cycle.
